description: This file defines a generic interface 'DataPopulator' for data conversion utilities within the project. It declares methods for populating or converting data from a source object to a target object, potentially considering store and language context.

classes.name: DataPopulator
classes.description: A generic interface facilitating data population or conversion between source and target objects within the sales manager application.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts or populates data from a source object to a target object, considering merchant store and language, possibly throwing a ConversionException.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates or converts data from source to a new target object, considering merchant store and language, possibly throwing a ConversionException.
